title: 百度网盘授权
description: 输入百度网盘 Access Token：打开官方授权链接，登录并完成授权后，从浏览器地址栏 access_token= 后复制。Token 仅保存在本机，不会上传。有效期 30 天，过期后需重新授权并更新。
description_en: Enter your Baidu Netdisk Access Token: open the official authorization link, sign in and authorize, then copy the access_token from the address bar. Stored locally only. Valid for 30 days; re-authorize after expiry.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.placeholder: 从授权成功页地址栏 access_token= 后复制
fields.placeholder_en: Copy from access_token= in the success page URL
fields.description: 打开官方授权链接并授权后，从跳转页地址栏复制 access_token（有效期 30 天，过期后需重新授权更新）
fields.description_en: Open the official authorization link, authorize, then copy access_token from the redirected URL (valid for 30 days)
